hydration_enthalpy_basis: Van't Hoff slope of equilibrium Eq. 24: delta_H = -R * 3769 K, reported as -31.4 kJ/mol in the primary study
model_scope: Pseudo-first-order aqueous hydration in excess water; k_d=k_h/K_h. The equilibrium slope supplies a partial hydration enthalpy, but no gas-water kLa, interface enhancement, acid/base extrapolation, heat capacity, or apparatus heat flow.
validation_use: Known HCN amounts are absent. Rates may be used only within the reported temperature and pH domain unless extrapolation is explicitly labeled.
